LEAID=5102670 | Norfolk City Public Schools, VIRGINIA | Step 1
============================================================
**Dr. James M. Pohl is the current Interim Superintendent of Norfolk Public Schools (Norfolk City Public Schools, Virginia) as of February 27, 2026, for the 2025–2026 school year.[1][1]**

## Leadership Timeline
Dr. Sharon Byrdsong was terminated in June 2025, after which the School Board appointed Dr. James M. Pohl as Interim Superintendent on June 11, 2025.[1][3][1]  
A search began in September 2025, leading to Dr. Jeff Rose (also Jeffrey W. Rose, Ed.D.) being selected as the next superintendent on January 30, 2026, in a 4-3 vote.[3][4][6]  
Dr. Rose's planned start date of February 23, 2026, was postponed due to a delay in Virginia Department of Education licensure processing, despite his application being submitted December 2, 2025.[4][9][10]

## Current Status
District pages, including the Office of the Superintendent, list Dr. Pohl as the serving interim leader without noting a transition completion.[1][1][2]  
No news confirms Dr. Rose has assumed the role by February 27, 2026; he remains the incoming appointee pending licensure.[3][9][10]  
Per Virginia rules, the current serving superintendent (Dr. Pohl) holds the position until the successor's start.[9]

Based on my research of Leander ISD's official website and recent district news, **Chris Clark, Ed.D. is the current acting superintendent of Leander ISD for the 2025–2026 school year** [3].

## Background on the Leadership Transition

Former Superintendent Bruce Gearing announced on December 8, 2025, his intention to retire at the end of the 2025–26 school year [1]. In response, the Leander ISD Board of Trustees named Chris Clark as acting superintendent on December 11, 2025 [3]. Clark previously served as Deputy Superintendent of Learning and Innovation, a position he assumed in 2024 after joining the district in June 2023 as Assistant Superintendent of Curriculum and Instruction [3].

## Current Search Status

The district has launched an internal superintendent search with a formal timeline scheduled through April 2026 [11]. The Board announced the opening on February 6, 2026, with applications closing on February 25, 2026 [11]. Interviews are planned for March 25, 2026, with a final hiring decision targeted for April 30, 2026 [11].

============================================================
Based on my research, I have found clear and current information about Beresford School District 61-2's superintendent.

**Dr. Dustin Degen** is the superintendent of Beresford School District 61-2, South Dakota for the 2025–2026 school year. [6][10][13] Dr. Degen was hired as superintendent effective July 1, 2021, following his nine years of service as the 6-12 principal at Beresford. **Key findings:**

1. **Alfonso Q. Llano Jr.** was the superintendent of Vineland Public Schools from 2021 until his resignation on January 7, 2026, when he was approved by the New Jersey State Board of Education to become superintendent of Camden City Schools, effective March 1, 2026. [2][3]

2. **Leadership transition underway:** As of February 11-12, 2026, the district website indicates that a superintendent search is actively underway through Hazard, Young, Attea & Associates (HYA). [5][8]

3. **Disputed appointment:** News from February 23, 2026 (just four days before today) reports that the Vineland School Board voted to appoint **Roberto Euresti** as the new superintendent, though this decision was controversial and not unanimous. [1][9]

4. **Current situation as of today (February 27, 2026):** According to the district's Superintendent Search page, Alfonso Llano's resignation takes effect today, February 27, 2026. [13]

**Critical assessment:** The most recent authoritative information (the district website search page from web:13) states that Llano's resignation is effective today. The very recent news (February 23) indicates the Board voted to appoint Roberto Euresti, but given the controversy, the lack of an official district announcement confirming his current status, and the timing, there is structural uncertainty about who is actually serving as superintendent at this moment.

Based on my research, I have found conflicting information about the superintendent of Elk Township School District. Here's what I discovered:

## Superintendent Information

The most authoritative source is the Aura Elementary School administration page, which lists [8] **Mr. Fran Ciociola** as Superintendent of Elk Township School District. This is the district's official website for the single school in this district.

However, there is a complication: I found evidence that Fran Ciociola is also the superintendent of Delsea Regional School District [27], for which he recently received a contract extension through 2028 [21]. This raises the question of whether he currently serves Elk Township, Delsea Regional, or both positions simultaneously.

The most recent information from the Aura Elementary School website [8] identifies Mr. Fran Ciociola as superintendent. Earlier sources, including a 2020 Wikipedia entry [1], also listed **Dr. Piera Gravenor** as superintendent, but there is no recent evidence that she remains in that position.

============================================================
Based on my research, I found relevant information about the superintendent of Belleville School District, Wisconsin for 2025–2026. According to the most recent source from The Monroe Times (January 2026, current school year), the district is actively engaged in community planning, confirming ongoing operations. 

From the search results, I identified that [2] from March 2024 confirms that James "Jim" Schmitt was approved by the Belleville Board of Education as the District Administrator and was set to begin his duties on July 1, 2024. In Wisconsin, the position is titled "District Administrator" rather than superintendent, and this is the top leader role for the district.

The Monroe Times article [19] also references Schmitt's appointment as the new District Administrator. Given that there is no departure news from 2024–2026, and his appointment was to a position with typical 5–6 year tenure, Jim Schmitt should be the current District Administrator serving for the 2025–2026 school year.

Additionally, [21], a Wisconsin superintendent contacts document dated January 2024, lists "Nate Perry" as the district leader, but this predates Schmitt's official July 1, 2024 start date, and another source [8] from 2022 also references Perry. Schmitt's appointment in March 2024 (approved for July 1, 2024 start) supersedes these older references.

LEAID=3414400 | Rumson-Fair Haven Regional High School District, NEW JERSEY | Step 1
============================================================
**Dr. Lee McDonald is the superintendent of the Rumson-Fair Haven Regional High School District for the 2025–2026 school year.** [6][4]

## Confirmation
The district's official administration page lists Dr. Lee McDonald as Superintendent with contact extension x551 and email lmcdonald@rumsonfairhaven.org. A May 2025 district announcement confirms the Board approved him on February 26, 2025, with his official start on April 14, 2025—well before the school year began in August 2025. As a single-school district, he serves as the top leader, and no newer news indicates a change as of February 2026.[14][4]

## Prior Leadership
Darren J. Groh was appointed in 2022 through June 2026, but a 2024 job posting sought his replacement starting July 1, 2025, aligning with McDonald's hiring. Wikipedia mentions an interim like Peter Righi, but district sources override this.[4][8][1]

LEAID=4842480 | TEXARKANA ISD, TEXAS | Step 1
============================================================
Based on my research of Texarkana ISD's official website and current district records, **Dr. Doug Brubaker is the Superintendent of Schools for Texarkana ISD for the 2025–2026 school year** [1][5].

## Superintendent Information

Dr. Doug Brubaker serves as Superintendent of Schools with administrative offices at 4241 Summerhill Road, Texarkana, Texas 75503 [1]. He can be reached at 903.794.3651 or via email at doug.brubaker@txkisd.net [1].

## Background

Dr. Brubaker has 28 years of public school experience, having served as a teacher, assistant principal, principal, department director, assistant superintendent, associate superintendent, and superintendent in districts throughout Texas and Arkansas, including Birdville ISD, Mansfield ISD, Carroll ISD, Carrollton-Farmers Branch ISD, Garland ISD, and Fort Smith Public Schools [1]. He holds a PhD in Educational Computing with a Concentration in Educational Administration from the University of North Texas, a Master's in Elementary Education from Texas Christian University, and a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from the University of Kansas [1]. He began his role as superintendent at Texarkana ISD in January 2021 [11].
